source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The original incremental handler sends target.getAttribute directly to clone.setAttribute. When the source attribute is absent, this does not remove the clone attribute; the null value is converted to text. Fixed accepted code instead checks hasAttribute and calls removeAttribute for that case. This distinction matters for presence-based attributes such as selected. The source trace identifies the later repair; no selection or discovery failure was reproduced.
title: Account Hub option synchronization must preserve attribute removal as absence
